questions: If the maximum value letter appears multiple times in the data, should the highlight bar be drawn on top of the existing bar (overwriting it) or as a separate bar (potentially causing two bars for the same letter)?

Should the highlight bar for the maximum value letter be drawn even if that letter does not appear in the dataset (i.e., the max value letter from the data tuples might not be in the counted letters)?
How should ties for the maximum value be handled? Should all tied letters be highlighted, or only one (and if so, which one)?
Is the dataset guaranteed to contain only lowercase letters, or should the function handle uppercase or non-alphabetic characters?
Should the bars be ordered alphabetically on the x-axis, by frequency, or in the order of first appearance in the dataset?
What should happen if the dataset is empty? Should the function raise an error, return an empty plot, or something else?
Should the function clear any existing matplotlib figure, or should it plot on the current axes if one exists?
Is the 'maximum value' determined by the second element of each tuple (item[1]), or by the frequency count of the first element?
